desc: A well-formed cluster that already follows the code-formatting house rule: a mention of code inside a question is inline code (`print`), a bare method name as the whole answer is inline code (`table.sort`), and a whole-answer command and a whole-answer one-line statement are fenced code blocks with language tags (`lua game.lua`, `{name = "Ada"}`). Every note is atomic and in house style. The correct behavior is to propose nothing and finish. Negative task guarding against an over-eager curator applying the code-formatting rule to already-correct usage.
